story: An icon of the skies, the White Bellied Sea Eagle (Icthyophaga leucogaster) is a species from the Accipitridae family. It thrives in Coastal areas; estuaries; inland waterbodies; and major waterways, where it interacts with its environment in unique ways. Understanding the needs of the White Bellied Sea Eagle helps us better comprehend the challenges facing our planet's wildlife. This poster is a celebration of the White Bellied Sea Eagle, a bird that inspires wonder and highlights the critical importance of conservation efforts.
